title: Why Does Counterintuitive Likelihood Behavior Rarely Emerge in Tabular Anomaly Detection?
abstract: arXiv:2602.09593v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep generative models with tractable likelihoods, exemplified by normalizing flows, offer an effective basis for anomaly detection through likelihood-based scoring. We demonstrate that, unlike in the image domain where deep generative models frequently assign higher likelihoods to anomalous data, such counterintuitive behavior occurs rarely in tabular settings. We first introduce a domain-agnostic formulation that enables consistent detection and evaluation of the counterintuitive phenomenon, addressing the lack of a precise definition in prior work. Through extensive experiments on 47 tabular datasets benchmarked against 13 baseline models and on 10 CV/NLP embedding datasets from ADBench, we show that the phenomenon is consistently rare in general tabular data and that normalizing flow likelihood achieves competitive anomaly detection performance. translated_title: 为什么反直觉的似然行为在表格异常检测中很少出现？
translated_abstract: 具有可处理似然的深度生成模型，以标准化流（normalizing flows）为代表，为基于似然评分的异常检测提供了有效基础。我们证明，与图像领域中深度生成模型经常为异常数据分配更高似然的情况不同，这种反直觉行为在表格数据环境中很少发生。我们首先引入了一个与领域无关的形式化框架，使得能够对这一反直觉现象进行一致的检测和评估，解决了以往工作中缺乏精确定义的问题。通过对47个表格数据集（与13个基线模型进行基准对比）以及来自ADBench的10个CV/NLP嵌入数据集的大量实验，我们表明该现象在一般表格数据中始终很少见，并且标准化流似然能够实现具有竞争力的异常检测性能。我们进一步提供了理论和实证分析，将这一差异归因于……
tldr: 本文提出了一个领域无关的反直觉似然现象形式化定义，并通过大规模实验与理论分析证明：与图像领域不同，反直觉的似然行为在表格异常检测中很少出现，且标准化流似然可实现有竞争力的异常检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a domain-agnostic formulation of the counterintuitive likelihood phenomenon and demonstrates through extensive experiments and theoretical analysis that, unlike in the image domain, counterintuitive likelihood behavior rarely emerges in tabular anomaly detection, where normalizing flow likelihood achieves competitive detection performance.
